sentences.s: Allen's contribution was to take an assumption we all share – that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts – and reveal its erroneous nature.

trunk.宾语或表语: to take an assumption we all share – that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts – and reveal its erroneous nature
trunk.主干翻译: 艾伦的贡献在于拿出一个假设并揭示其谬误所在。

components.原文: we all share
components.中文翻译: 我们都认同的
components.说明: 限定性定语从句修饰 an assumption，省略了关系代词 that/which。

components.原文: that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts
components.中文翻译: 因为我们不是机器人，所以能控制自己的思想
components.说明: that 引导同位语从句，破折号引出，解释 assumption 的具体内容。

components.原文: because we are not robots
components.中文翻译: 因为我们不是机器人
components.说明: 内嵌于同位语从句的原因状语从句，与后面 therefore 呼应。

components.原文: and reveal its erroneous nature
components.中文翻译: 并揭示其谬误的本质
components.说明: 不定式 reveal 与 to take 并列，共同作表语。

sentences.zh: 艾伦的贡献在于，他拿出“我们并不是机器人，所以能控制自己的思想”这一公认的假设，并揭示了其谬误所在。

sentences.s: while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone, in reality we are continually faced with a question: ``Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?\,''

trunk.主干翻译: 现实中我们不断要面对一个问题。

components.原文: while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone
components.中文翻译: 尽管我们或许可以仅凭意识来维系“控制”这种错觉
components.说明: while 引导让步状语从句，与主句 in reality 形成转折对比。

components.原文: through the conscious mind alone
components.中文翻译: 仅凭意识
components.说明: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰 sustain。

components.原文: in reality
components.中文翻译: 现实中
components.说明: 介词短语作状语，暗含与前面让步分句的转折关系。

components.原文: ``Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?\,''
components.中文翻译: “我为什么不能让自己做这个或实现那个？”
components.说明: 直接引语作 a question 的同位语，说明所面对问题的具体内容。

sentences.zh: 尽管我们或许可以仅凭意识来维系“控制”这种错觉，现实中我们还是不断要面对一个问题：“我为什么不能让自己做这个或实现那个？”

sentences.s: This seems a justification for neglect of those in need, and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom.

trunk.宾语或表语: a justification for neglect of those in need, and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom
trunk.主干翻译: 这似乎是一种辩护，也是一种合理化的说法。

components.原文: for neglect of those in need
components.中文翻译: 为忽视贫困者的行为
components.说明: 介词短语作 a justification 的后置定语。

components.原文: and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom
components.中文翻译: 以及为剥削、为社会上层人群的优越和社会底层人群的卑微找理由
components.说明: a rationalization 与 a justification 并列，共作 seems 的表语。

components.原文: of exploitation
components.中文翻译: 对剥削的
components.说明: 介词短语作 a rationalization 的后置定语之一。

components.原文: of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom
components.中文翻译: 对社会上层人群的优越和社会底层人群的卑微的
components.说明: 与 of exploitation 并列，同作 a rationalization 的后置定语。

sentences.zh: 这似乎是在为忽视贫困者的行为作辩护，为剥削、为社会上层人群的优越及社会底层人群的卑微找理由。

sentences.s: circumstances seem to be designed to bring out the best in us, and if we feel that we have been ``wronged'' then we are unlikely to begin a conscious effort to escape from our situation.

trunk.主干翻译: 环境仿佛是被设计用来激发我们最大潜能的。

components.原文: to bring out the best in us
components.中文翻译: 以激发我们的最大潜能
components.说明: 不定式短语作目的状语，说明 designed 的目的。

components.原文: and if we feel that we have been ``wronged'' then we are unlikely to begin a conscious effort to escape from our situation
components.中文翻译: 如果我们觉得自己遭受了“不公”，就不太可能有意识地去努力摆脱自己的处境
components.说明: 由 and 连接的并列分句，内含条件状语从句。

components.原文: if we feel that we have been ``wronged''
components.中文翻译: 如果我们觉得自己遭受了“不公”
components.说明: if 引导条件状语从句，与 then 主句呼应。

components.原文: that we have been ``wronged''
components.中文翻译: 自己遭受了“不公”
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句，作 feel 的宾语。

components.原文: to escape from our situation
components.中文翻译: 去摆脱我们处境的
components.说明: 不定式短语作 a conscious effort 的后置定语。

sentences.zh: 环境仿佛就是为了激发我们的最大潜能而设，如果我们觉得自己遭受了“不公”，就不太可能有意识地去努力摆脱自己的处境。

sentences.s: The upside is the possibilities contained in knowing that everything is up to us; where before we were experts in the array of limitations, now we become authorities of what is possible.

trunk.宾语或表语: the possibilities contained in knowing that everything is up to us
trunk.主干翻译: 其好处在于：“认识到一切都取决于我们自己”这一认识本身所蕴含的种种可能性。

components.原文: contained in knowing that everything is up to us
components.中文翻译: 蕴含于“认识到一切都取决于我们自己”之中的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作 the possibilities 的后置定语。

components.原文: that everything is up to us
components.中文翻译: 一切都取决于我们自己
components.说明: that 引导宾语从句，作动名词 knowing 的宾语。

components.原文: where before we were experts in the array of limitations, now we become authorities of what is possible
components.中文翻译: 从前我们是各种局限性方面的专家，如今我们却成了判断什么是可能的权威
components.说明: 分号后的并列分句，以 before…now… 形成今昔对比。

components.原文: what is possible
components.中文翻译: 什么是可能的
components.说明: what 引导从句作介词 of 的宾语，即 authorities 所判定的对象。

sentences.zh: 其正面意义在于，“认识到一切都取决于我们自己”这一认识本身蕴含着种种可能性；从前我们是各种局限性方面的专家，如今我们却成了判断什么才有可能的权威。
